source_quality_notes.detail: Visual verification of both figures shows six cases in 1998, eleven in 2006 and three in 2008. These values fall outside the narrative annual ranges (generally 0–5 in 1994–2005 and 6–10 in 2006–2010). Use period totals supported by both the plotted/tabulated annual counts and the Results. Year-specific series is withheld pending reconciliation with source records.

source_quality_notes.locator: Results, printed p971 (PDF p4); limitations, printed pp972–973 (PDF pp5–6)
source_quality_notes.detail: The paper reports that 76% of cases followed operational sorties. Operational-only sortie counts were classified and unavailable to the study; the published rates use overall sortie data. Exact period sortie counts were not verified. Do not derive counts from rounded rates.
